trigger.note: ST43 (paid base reel spin) triggers the FreeSpin feature via ReMarks='TriggerFreespin' (3182/424000 in-sample). ST44 is the granted free reel spin (cost=0, ReMarks='FreeSpin'; chains 43->44->44...->43). Both STs settle via their NATIVE PayoutIdToWinAmount payids — no synthesized pid needed (0/424000 ST43 and 0/22274 ST44 win-without-payid). No live collect channel (no SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols).

validation.evidence: W4 (onboard-implementer, 2026-06-18; 424000 ST43 + 22274 ST44 rounds across 25 real _cache_version:3 chunks, single config bucket e7f4aa3f/8067f1ba, _bet=1000, no _dev_sample). ST inventory = 2 SpinTypes, both the STANDARD full-reel signature (StopSymbolsByCol+PayoutByPayline+PayoutIdToWinAmount+RewardLastNode+ReelSkin+ReMarks+WinCredits) — EXACT field-signature match to confirmed sibling M87. ST43 role=paid_spin (CostCredits=1000, ReMarks empty x420818 / 'TriggerFreespin' x3182 -> opens freespin; FeatureWin base key 'NormalFreeSpin'); ST44 role=freespin (CostCredits=0 granted, ReMarks='FreeSpin' x22274; FeatureWin key 'FreeSpin'). Machine's own analysisResult taxonomy = TotalWin{Normal} + FeatureWin{NormalFreeSpin, FreeSpin} + SummaryWin{NormalFreeSpin, FreeSpin}. NO live-collect channel (SymbolIndexToRewards/CollectCount/CreditsSymbols absent on 100% of rounds); EVERY win round carries a populated native PayoutIdToWinAmount -> ZERO win-without-payid -> no additive collect residual, no synth rule. CurJackpotStoreWin present on 100% of rounds but =0 on 100% (test-interface-zeroed, fleet-wide behavior). Both STs supportable manifest-only via the generic PER_SPINTYPE plugins (paid_spin) + the existing freespin_dynamics plugin (freespin role, already validated/wired in ROLE_ANALYSES). No NEW plugin, no wiring change, no synth rule. base_hash unchanged 3ddaa183f38c. rtp_integrity.paid_st=[43] (ST44 cost=0 excluded from RTP denominator). Awaiting onboard-tester + breaker + user domain sign-off (gate 8).
caveats: ST44 freespin per-round retrigger-depth / free-spin-count histogram needs per-round sequence accumulation in parser.py (base-closure) — freespin_dynamics surfaces the base-excluded aggregate; the depth histogram is parser_blind. Framework-team item (same per-ST-extraction boundary as M43 minigame node-list).

Per-skin (ReelSkin) labeled breakout is parser_blind: the plugin layer receives coarse per-ST RETURN_BUCKET histograms, not per-round ReelSkin (same boundary as M279 skin-11). The skin's CONTRIBUTION is captured (pooled into the per-ST multiplier distribution). Framework-team item IF a labeled per-skin metric is wanted.

out_of_engine_mechanics.name: CurJackpotStoreWin progressive (test-interface-zeroed)
out_of_engine_mechanics.desc: Field 'CurJackpotStoreWin' is present on every ST43/ST44 round but =0 on 100% of in-sample records. FLEET-WIDE test-interface behavior (user-confirmed 2026-06-12, M275 gate 8): a real progressive jackpot store whose accumulation efficiency the CURRENT testspin interface forces to 0 (so the sample correctly shows 0). Parse as-is with the progressive contributing 0; the field is already in the ST43/ST44 signature, so parsing is FORWARD-COMPATIBLE — when the test interface is optimized to populate it, the existing parser picks it up unchanged. The data RTP is the BASE RTP (excludes the progressive); the progressive ADDS on top once the interface enables it.
